userId.description: Reference to users._id, or null when the quiz is taken without logging in.

productIds.description: The quiz's top matches, best first. Order is meaningful, which is why this is an array and not a set of separate fields. Foreign keys to products.id.

takenAt.description: When the customer finished the quiz. A real BSON date. The browser currently writes an ISO string, so the API must convert it on insert: see SCHEMA.md.
